author: Corridor Crew
description:
The Exorcist director William Friedkin was not messing around with the filming of Sorcerer in 1977. Unsatisfied with the practical "Hollywood movie explosion" his VFX supervisor prepared for this scene, he flew in an Arsonist to create a real explosion with homemade explosives.

Do you think the result looks better than the typical Hollywood explosion?
title: This is What a REAL EXPLOSION Looks Like..
